tools.name: get_proof_status
tools.description: Returns the current primary-source status of the November 2026 Lean 4 Riemann Hypothesis proof (formal verification status, human-readable paper progress, Clay $1M prize status, key metrics, and primary URLs).

tools.name: list_verifications
tools.description: Returns the full independent verification matrix (Mathlib statement match, offline MIT sandbox 61.57 GB export replay, axiom audit, nanoda, con-leche, con-ron, lean4lean, leanchecker) plus unsettled open items.

tools.name: list_reactions
tools.description: Returns primary-source quotes and analysis from mathematicians, Lean verifiers, critical skeptics, parallel human-proof authors, and institutions, optionally filtered by stance.

tools.name: list_updates
tools.description: Returns reverse-chronological daily updates on independent verifications, proof simplifications, mathematician commentary, and Clay Mathematics Institute status.

tools.name: list_videos
tools.description: Returns the episode roadmap and published links for the Riemann Wiki visual mathematics documentary series.
